verdict.rationale: Porkbun ships a live, probe-verified llms.txt (HTTP 200) plus llms-full.txt, agent-oriented guides (e.g. /llms/guides/*, /llms/agent-setup) and even a dedicated agent-setup instruction page telling AI coding agents to configure the API themselves, alongside an official MCP server. This directly matches the story of pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent docs. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) confirmation that agents successfully consume these docs in practice.
